t: $(thing)Modules/$ are inserted into an $(l:intro/modular_router)Modular Router/$ and tell the router what to do. There are 20 different module types, each of which has a specific function.  All modules have some characteristics in common, however:$(li)All modules have 9 $(thing)filter slots/$ to control which item(s) a module will process.$(li)Many modules have a defined $(thing)direction/$, relative to the router's facing.
$(thing)模块/$会被插入到$(l:intro/modular_router)物品路由器/$中，并告诉路由器该做什么。模块共有 20 种不同类型，每种都有特定功能。不过，所有模块都有一些共同特征：$(li)所有模块都有 9 个$(thing)过滤器槽位/$，用于控制模块会处理哪些物品。$(li)许多模块还定义了相对于路由器朝向的$(thing)方向/$。

$(li)Some modules have extra settings for configuring module-specific functionality.$(p)All this can be configured in the module's GUI, which you can access by $(thing)Right-Clicking/$ the module in hand.$(p)You can also configure an installed module in a router GUI by pressing $(4)$(bold)[$(k:modularrouters.configure)]/$ while hovering over it, or $(thing)Middle-Clicking/$ the module in the GUI, without needing to remove it from the router.

$(li)某些模块还带有额外设置，用于配置该模块特有的功能。$(p)这些都可以在模块的 GUI 中进行配置，而你只需手持模块并$(thing)右键单击/$即可打开。$(p)你还可以在路由器 GUI 中对已安装的模块进行配置：将鼠标悬停其上时按下 $(4)$(bold)[$(k:modularrouters.configure)]/$，或直接在 GUI 中对模块$(thing)中键单击/$，无需先将其从路由器中取出。
$(italic)Module GUI: see following pages for a description of each part of the GUI/$
$(italic)模块 GUI：下一页将说明 GUI 各部分的用途/$

There are nine filter slots, where you can insert ghost copies of any item or block. The module will only operate if the item in the router's $(thing)buffer/$ matches an item in the module's filter (if whitelisting; the opposite if blacklisting).
共有九个过滤槽位，你可在其中插入任意物品或方块的幽灵副本。模块仅在路由器$(thing)缓存/$中的物品与模块过滤器中的某项匹配时（白名单模式下；黑名单模式则相反）才会运行。

Most modules operate in a defined direction, relative to the router's facing. Here you can define the direction.$(p)Some modules (e.g. the $(l:modules/sender2)Sender Mk2/$) target a distant block directly, so do not have a definable direction. In this case, the direction selector will be blank.
大多数模块都会相对于路由器朝向，在某个已定义的方向上工作。你可以在这里设置这个方向。$(p)某些模块（例如$(l:modules/sender2)发送模块2型/$）会直接以远处方块为目标，因此没有可定义的方向。这种情况下，方向选择器会是空白的。

Here there are several buttons which control:$(li)Whitelisting vs. blacklisting$(li)Whether to match item damage (for items with durability)$(li)Whether to match item NBT, e.g. enchantments$(li)Whether to match by $(l:https://minecraft.gamepedia.com/Tag)item tags/$$(p)There is also a button here to control $(l:router/termination)Termination Behaviour/$, which is explained in a separate page.
这里有几个按钮，用于控制：$(li)白名单或黑名单$(li)是否匹配物品损伤值（针对有耐久的物品）$(li)是否匹配物品 NBT，例如附魔$(li)是否按$(l:https://minecraft.gamepedia.com/Tag)物品标签/$进行匹配$(p)这里还有一个按钮用于控制$(l:router/termination)终止行为/$，相关说明见单独页面。

Every module has four $(thing)Augment/$ slots where augments (module-specific upgrades) can be inserted.$(p)The Augments which may be inserted here depend on the module type; not every module type accepts every augment type.
每个模块都有四个$(thing)增强件/$槽位，可插入增强件（模块专用升级）。$(p)这里能插入哪些增强件取决于模块类型；并不是每种模块都接受每一种增强件。

Some modules have some extra configuration options. For example, the $(l:modules/detector)Detector Module/$ shown earlier has options to set the redstone output level, and whether the output signal should be a weak or strong redstone signal.$(p)Where modules have such options, they're shown on the right-hand side of the GUI.
某些模块具有额外的配置选项。例如，前面展示的$(l:modules/detector)检测模块/$可以设置红石输出等级，以及输出信号是弱红石信号还是强红石信号。$(p)如果模块具有此类选项，它们会显示在 GUI 的右侧。
